subject: Co-branding lockup & customer spotlight publicity for CortexGen rollout
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cortexai.com>, Marcus D'Souza <marcus@cortexai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Co-branding lockup & customer spotlight publicity for CortexGen rollout

Hi Elena & Marcus —

Congrats again on the CortexGen launch — the demo yesterday showed great latency/cost improvements and the case study draft we produced is ready for your review. We'd love to publish a short customer spotlight on our blog and co-promote it on social channels. Specific asks: 

- Permission to use Cortex AI logo (color + monochrome) in a ‘Customer Spotlight’ byline and in a co-branded hero lockup on the blog and one-pager.
- Approval of two short quotes from Marcus included in the draft (attached).
- Confirmation of any branding constraints (clear space, color usage) and any legal language you need us to include.

Attached: redwood-case-draft-v1.pdf (draft spotlight + two proposed quote callouts).

If this looks OK at a high level, can you send the official logo files and any co-branding guidelines? We can incorporate any edits and route to your legal/comms for final sign-off. Goal: publish the week of Nov 22 if we can get approvals.

Thanks —
Jonas
Director, Customer Marketing
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: redwood-case-draft-v1.pdf (17 pages, images stub)

From: Elena Rossi <elena@cortexai.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus D'Souza <marcus@cortexai.com>, legal@cortexai.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Co-branding lockup & customer spotlight publicity for CortexGen rollout

Hi Jonas —

Thanks — we enjoyed the session as well. We're generally happy to be featured and to provide co-branding assets. I've attached our official logo files and the co-branding guidelines (please follow the lockup spacing rules on page 3).

A couple of requests from our side:
- Please do not change the quote wording from Marcus without prior approval (small punctuation is fine, but no paraphrasing).
- Avoid using specific performance numbers unless you cite the benchmark in the article. If you'd like to include the 3.2x throughput improvement, we need to reference our internal benchmark doc (we can provide a short excerpt).
- Legal asked that we exchange a short co-branding acknowledgement PDF (attached) and that your legal team confirms the final copy before publishing.

Attachments: Cortex_Logo_Color.svg, Cortex_CoBranding_Guidelines.pdf, Cortex_DocuSign_CoBranding_Ack.pdf

I'll let legal handle the signature piece; looping them in (legal@cortexai.com).

Best,
Elena
VP, Marketing
Cortex AI

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Co-branding lockup & customer spotlight publicity for CortexGen rollout

Marissa / Laura —

Looping you in. Cortex has provided logos and a DocuSign co-branding acknowledgement that they want signed before we publish. They also flagged two constraints: (1) don't alter Marcus's quote text without sign-off, and (2) don't publish specific performance numbers unless we cite their internal benchmark.

Marissa: can you review the draft (attached again) and make any final editorial edits that keep the customer voice intact? Goal is: final copy + logo lockup + signed acknowledgement by EOD Nov 20 so we can publish next week.

Laura: please review the attached DocuSign ack and confirm whether we need to propose edits or whether we can sign as-is. If you need a small redline, please advise the exact wording to send back to Elena.

Thanks —
Jonas

---
Attachment: redwood-case-draft-v1.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Co-branding lockup & customer spotlight publicity for CortexGen rollout

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the DocuSign ack and the logos. High level: we're comfortable with the logo usage and the lockup rules in their guidelines. A few small legal notes: 

1) Quote handling — we need explicit permission to use Marcus's quote verbatim (Cortex's legal would have to sign off on that point). Since they are the quote owner, that's standard; ask Marcus to reply in-thread confirming the exact phrasing.

2) Performance claims — good call to avoid standalone numbers. If we include the 3.2x throughput stat, add a parenthetical citing “Cortex internal benchmark, Oct 2026; results may vary” and mark that sentence as conditional on receiving the benchmark excerpt.

3) Co-branding acknowledgement — the DocuSign file looks standard. I made one minor redline request to Section 2.2 that limits the use of co-branding to marketing collateral for mutually agreed joint announcements only; this prevents repackaging as third-party endorsements. Please see the redline comments in the attached DocuSign. If they accept that single change we can sign.

Recommend: Jonas send a short email to Elena/Marcus with the exact quote text for Marcus to confirm, attach the redlined ack (or link to DocuSign comments), and ask for final sign-off by Nov 23. I'll be standing by to countersign once they accept the change.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Cortex_DocuSign_CoBranding_Ack.pdf (redline comments added)

From: Elena Rossi <elena@cortexai.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus D'Souza <marcus@cortexai.com>, legal@cortexai.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Co-branding lockup & customer spotlight publicity for CortexGen rollout

Hi Jonas / Laura —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Marcus has confirmed the quote below and approves verbatim use: "Redwood's runtime cut our inference latency in half while reducing per-token cost — the impact on our production pipelines was immediate."

We reviewed your redline in Section 2.2 and are OK with the suggested restriction to joint announcements. I asked our legal team to accept the single redline; they've updated the DocuSign accordingly and e-signed the acknowledgement. The signed PDF is attached and the DocuSign room link is here: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/ABCD-1234

We're happy for you to proceed with the publish plan for the week of Nov 29. Please send a final copy to me for a quick proof read before it goes live.

Best,
Elena
VP, Marketing
Cortex AI

---
Attachments: Cortex_DocuSign_CoBranding_Ack.pdf (executed), Cortex_Logo_Color.svg
